title: '8K Blu-ray would be a technical feat in search of a problem to solve’: I talked to the Blu-ray Disc Association, player manufacturers and TV makers about what comes after 4K Blu-ray, and the future of physical media
excerpt: I dug into the future of physical movie collecting with the people behind the technology.
content_html:
Blu-ray turned 20 this year, and although streaming is now the way most people watch films, physical media is dead is far from dead. Collectors are still buying Blu-rays for their new restorations, special features or limited-edition packages — and younger audiences are discovering the value of owning their films rather than dealing with your favorites disappearing on your all the time.

History lesson

Blu-ray replaced DVD in the mid-2000s. Named after the blue-violet laser it uses to read data, it offered high-definition video and much greater storage capacity. In 2016, Ultra HD Blu-ray was introduced, which added 4K resolution and HDR.

Throughout this article, when industry experts refer to “Blu-ray”, they're generally talking about that latest version, Ultra HD Blu-ray, as it's still considered the highest-quality consumer format for watching films at home.

So if people still want to watch movies on discs at home, is there a Blu-ray successor on the horizon to offer something new?

Every major home video format before it has eventually been replaced. VHS gave way to DVD, then DVD gave way to Blu-ray. As someone who appreciates the quality of Blu-ray films but isn't an expert in the technology behind them, I assumed there would be a straightforward plan for something to come supplant them. Maybe an 8K Blu-ray? Maybe another physical format I've never heard of because home cinema is an interest of mine rather than my specialism?

But after speaking to analysts, hardware manufacturers and the organization behind Blu-ray itself, I discovered that most of them don't think another disc is coming. In fact, there’s no obvious "next format" about to be unveiled, and I wanted to find out why.

Why Blu-ray still has loyal fans

To understand why the future of Blu-ray is such an interesting topic, it's worth first getting to grips with why people still buy it. And the top reason came up in every conversation I had: ownership.

"Ownership matters more now than it did in 2005. When you buy a disc, you own that film. It’s yours, permanently, in its best possible form, sitting on your shelf whenever you want it,” says Victor Matsuda, Chairman of the Blu-ray Disc Association, the group behind the development of Blu-ray.

He tells me that people are switching on to the fact that most of what we “buy” digitally today is really a license that can change or disappear. His comments come shortly after Sony removed over 500 purchased movies from people's accounts without compensation, and right at the same time as Disney+ was forced to remove 4K and HDR support in many countries.

“We frequently hear complaints about people losing access to content they thought they’d purchased, and there have even been lawsuits brought on exactly this issue,” Matsuda says. “A disc doesn’t have that problem. Nobody can reach into your home and take it back.”

I've spoken to many physical media collectors over the years, and ownership is almost always the first thing they mention. But the second reason is quality. Ultra HD Blu-ray is still widely considered to be the best technology for watching films at home.

"20 years ago, Blu-ray set the standard for what a movie should look and sound like in the home, and it’s a standard both consumers and the industry recognized,” Matsuda tells me. “Ultra HD Blu-ray remains unsurpassed as the best overall experience for consumers.”

He explains that this has been the case even as streaming services have rolled out 4K and HDR. “The respective Blu-ray formats became the benchmark they chased, and in my opinion they still haven’t caught it. Blu-ray and Ultra HD Blu-ray remain the reference,” Matsuda says. “A stream can approximate it, but the disc carries the full, uncompressed picture and sound with nothing thrown away to fit a data cap.”

Olivier Semenoux, Europe head of GTM and Product Management at TCL Electronics, explains that much of that comes down to bitrate. "Blu-ray can be coded up to 128Mbps because that's the disc's technical limit,” he explains. “Streaming is a different story, most popular platforms cap out natively around 25Mbps, with some going up to 40 or 80Mbps.”

Unfortunately, the latter is very rare — when it comes to the big streamers, 16 to 18Mbps is the maximum you can expect.

This means that Ultra HD Blu-rays carry significantly more data per frame than a typical stream, meaning less compression and what you see at home is more of the original picture and sound being preserved. It's one of the reasons discs continue to set the standard for anyone who really loves home theater.

Variations of the same argument came up repeatedly in conversations with manufacturers too. I spoke with Rob Jones, President of Magnetar, a manufacturer of high-end 4K UHD Blu-ray and universal disc players. “When consumers invest in physical media, they get ownership, content preservation, and quality control,” he says. “While streaming is incredibly convenient, it cannot match physical media when it comes to that combination.” Jones says that’s what continues to drive Magnetar’s investment and development in this space.

But that doesn't necessarily mean streaming and Blu-ray are in competition. One of the more surprising things I heard was that several companies see them as complementary rather than competing technologies.

"We see many customers choosing both formats," Kenichi Ikenoue, Head of Strategic Planning at Panasonic Consumer Europe, tells me. "They enjoy the convenience of streaming for everyday viewing while turning to physical media when they want the highest picture and sound quality or want to own their favorite films."

Why 8K isn’t the answer

If Blu-ray still has loyal fans, isn’t the next step an 8K successor? That's what I expected to find, as someone who isn't deep on movie production. Instead, almost every expert I spoke to questioned whether there was any need for a successor at all.

"Honestly, I don't think so, at least not right now," says Victor Matsuda. "From a BDA [Blu-ray Disc Association] perspective, we don't see anything from content creators or consumers to indicate a need for a new format. They’re both extremely satisfied.”

There are signs elsewhere that the industry isn't preparing for another optical disc format either. In 2025, Sony announced that it was ending the production of recordable Blu-ray discs, MiniDiscs and MiniDV cassettes, saying that there would be "no successor models". Now, while that decision applies to blank recording discs rather than pre-recorded movie discs, it seems to reflect a broader shift away from consumer physical media formats.

One obvious reason for a new format would be 8K support, which is a format that would theoretically offer four times the resolution of today's 4K discs. But that wasn't what the experts I spoke to had in mind.

"The resolution race is interesting, but I don't see 8K finding a place with consumers anytime soon," Matsuda says. "The content community, meaning the Hollywood studios, produces its content in 4K and has stated their intent to continue doing so. Additionally, a number of manufacturers have dropped 8K from their lineups."

Jones agreed that 8K isn't ready for the mainstream, but says the challenge goes beyond content. It's also about the wider home theater ecosystem. "8K is a distraction until it's mainstream and the ecosystem simply does not justify it," he says.

He points out that an 8K player wouldn't just require 8K discs, but would also depend on compatible TVs, projectors, AV receivers and processors. "In order to sit down and experience 8K content, a viewer's entire home entertainment chain needs to support 8K," he says. "A consumer would need to replace every single link in their entertainment chain with a component capable of supporting 8K, which is impractical at best."

And it seems as if lack of demand isn't the only reason experts are sceptical. Some argue we've reached the point where higher resolutions matter much less than other improvements we can make to picture quality. "HDR and wide colour gamut make a far bigger difference to perceived picture quality than resolution does," Semenoux tells me.

Which means the challenge facing an 8K Blu-ray isn't just about a lack of content or compatible hardware; it's that the improvement itself may not feel significant enough to justify an entirely new format.

That's exactly how Mark Vena, CEO and Principal Analyst at SmartTech Research, sees it. "Frankly, an 8K Blu-ray would be a technical feat in search of a commercial problem to solve,” he says. “There's still little native 8K content, 8K TV adoption is modest and streaming platforms will almost certainly meet mainstream demand before another optical format ever reaches critical mass."

In other words, it’s not as if we’re all sitting around waiting for a new format to happen, it’s more that it doesn’t really have a reason to exist.

What creates a new format?

Vena’s point made me realize I'd been thinking about this the wrong way. Every major home video format solved an obvious problem. DVD improved on VHS by offering non-degrading video and the capacity for extra features. Blu-ray improved on DVD with the space for higher-quality video. And now we have Ultra HD Blu-ray, which improved on Blu-ray's quality further.

Crucially, each of those steps solved a real technical problem. But right now, there isn’t a real problem that a successor to Ultra HD Blu-ray could actually solve.

Matsuda explained this to me using a framework from his time as a product planner that he calls "needs" and "seeds". A "need" is a problem consumers or the industry want solving. A "seed" is a new technology that has the potential to create that demand in the future.

"I don't see a compelling driver for a new format at the moment," Matsuda says. "I think it's unlikely that a new format would arise out of consumer demand as there doesn't appear to be an expressed need. Similarly, Ultra HD Blu-ray continues to deliver content that takes full advantage of display technologies so I don't see a need arising from the industry side."

Matsuda says that could change. "From a seed standpoint, companies may have some technologies in development that could plant those seeds,” he explains. “But in my view, if a driving factor ever prompts a new physical format, it will most likely be the emergence of content the internet infrastructure simply can't deliver at scale without compromising quality. As long as streaming can handle what people want to watch, I don't see any real pressure for a new disc."

So a technological breakthrough on its own wouldn't be enough, a new format would also need the entire industry to then build around it.

Panasonic’s Ikenoue makes the same point from a more commercial perspective. "A successor format would also depend on significant investment from film studios and content providers. New hardware alone would not be enough. The content ecosystem would also need to support a new format. For the moment it is difficult to see the requirement for a successor."

A successor wouldn't just need a better disc, there’d have to be a need to even build that better disc in the first place. Only then would studios create the content, manufacturers would build the players, TV makers would support it and consumers would decide if it was worth upgrading. But right now none of the experts could identify a good enough reason.

What if the successor isn’t a disc at all?

That doesn't necessarily mean Blu-ray is the end of the story. Optical storage technology is still evolving. Companies are developing discs capable of storing far more data than today's Blu-rays, but the key thing is that they're aimed at archiving data on an enterprise scale rather than at home entertainment. Which means they aren’t about to become the next movie format that you’ll buy.

Instead, several people I spoke with pointed towards a future where the successor to Blu-ray isn't about discs. "If Blu-ray has a successor, it may not be something you can hold in your hand," says Mark Vena. Rather than another physical format, he believes the future lies in premium digital delivery through high-quality, studio-certified, lossless downloads stored locally on home servers or network-attached storage.

"This is why the real successor to Blu-ray, for most consumers, is not another disc at all," he says. "It's the combination of ultra high bitrate streaming, cloud libraries and AI-powered video optimization that's closing the quality gap."

So maybe the future isn't about replacing Blu-ray with another physical format but instead preserving the quality of audio and visuals that enthusiasts value about Blu-ray without even needing a disc in the first place.

One possible future is already beginning to emerge. Kaleidescape, a company specializing in premium digital movie delivery, offers downloads with bitrates to match what Blu-ray is capable of, preserving much more picture and audio quality than traditional streaming services while still providing the convenience of instant access.

Kaleidescape even recently launched a new 'Cinematic 4K' format for movies, which it says will offer even higher-quality bitrates for video, promising over 100Mbps of average bitrate (not maximum), which it compared to 60Mbps of average bitrate for 4K Blu-ray in its own marketing materials.

"In 10 years, the highest-quality movies at home will be delivered digitally, not on disc," Tayloe Stansbury, chairman and CEO of Kaleidescape, tells me. "Consumers will expect instant access, reference-quality presentation, and technology that evolves with each generation of content. That's the future Kaleidescape is building today."

However, for many fans of Blu-ray, the biggest hurdle here is still ownership and Kaleidescape's technical proficiency doesn't address that. It's a digital storefront, and the same concerns of losing access to things you've bought still applies.

Kaleidescape told me that its priority is delivering the best possible digital collecting experience rather than addressing licensing, and it declined to comment on people's increasing concerns about this side of buying movies.

Digital purchases may be able to close the gap on quality, but until they can offer the same promise of permanence as a disc, then physical media will continue to offer something digital can't.

Blu-ray remains resilient

When I first started researching this story, I thought I'd be talking to experts about the technology that’s waiting to replace Blu-ray. But instead, I learned the future is a little more complicated than that.

Every home video format in the past has reached a point where its limitations became too impossible to ignore. But Ultra HD Blu-ray appears to be in a different position. According to the people building and supporting the format, there isn't an obvious problem left for another new type of disc to solve. It still delivers the highest quality experience available to most consumers and continues to attract collectors who are willing to invest in physical media.

Looking at recent sales numbers, the Blu-ray market is much healthier than I expected. Mark Frampton, Senior Commercial Marketing Manager at Elevation Sales, a film sales and distribution company, says the format has remained remarkably resilient.

"We’re forecasting 2026 to be another year where the market stabilizes. Catalogue [older releases] has been very strong and only 2% down year-on-year. This is driven by collector’s editions and steelbooks, particularly on 4K Ultra HD which remains a format in growth."

In other words, older film releases are continuing to sell well, with premium collector editions helping to keep the market strong — and it's not just older enthusiasts buying discs today.

“Although the core buying audience is still people over 35, we’re increasingly seeing younger audiences entering the market,” Frampton tells me. “People aged between 25 and 34 are the second biggest buyers of Blu-ray. But Gen Z and Younger Millennials (aged between 14 and 30) who are experiencing ‘digital fatigue’ are becoming highly engaged in the format as well."

The wider industry paints a similar picture. Kath Summersgill, Group Joint Head of Sales at Key Production Group, a music manufacturer that specializes in producing physical media, points to figures from the Entertainment Retailers Association showing continued growth. "The current state of the physical movie market is incredibly encouraging, with ERA’s 2025 figures showing Blu-ray sales increased by 19.5%,” she says.

Now, these surprisingly healthy numbers don’t mean Blu-ray discs will be around forever. Streaming will continue to improve, premium digital libraries will become more sophisticated and companies like Kaleidescape are already demonstrating that top-quality movies don't necessarily need to be on a disc.

All of this means another physical format may never arrive. Instead, the next chapter for home theater could be digital — but there's a long way before collectors would be ready to trust digital libraries.

For now, at least you know you won't have to worry about buying your favorite movies yet again on another new disc format in the future.

blocks.html_en: To understand why the future of Blu-ray is such an interesting topic, it's worth first getting to grips with why people still buy it. And the top reason came up in every conversation I had: ownership.

sentences.en: To understand why the future of Blu-ray is such an interesting topic, it's worth first getting to grips with why people still buy it.

sentences.en: And the top reason came up in every conversation I had: ownership.
sentences.zh: 在我的每一次谈话中，最重要的原因都是：所有权。

blocks.html_en: "Ownership matters more now than it did in 2005. When you buy a disc, you own that film. It’s yours, permanently, in its best possible form, sitting on your shelf whenever you want it,” says Victor Matsuda, Chairman of the Blu-ray Disc Association, the group behind the development of Blu-ray.

sentences.en: It’s yours, permanently, in its best possible form, sitting on your shelf whenever you want it,” says Victor Matsuda, Chairman of the Blu-ray Disc Association, the group behind the development of Blu-ray.

sentences.en: His comments come shortly after Sony removed over 500 purchased movies from people's accounts without compensation, and right at the same time as Disney+ was forced to remove 4K and HDR support in many countries.

blocks.html_en: I've spoken to many physical media collectors over the years, and ownership is almost always the first thing they mention. But the second reason is quality. Ultra HD Blu-ray is still widely considered to be the best technology for watching films at home.

sentences.en: I've spoken to many physical media collectors over the years, and ownership is almost always the first thing they mention.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我与许多实体媒体收藏家交谈过，所有权几乎总是他们提到的第一件事。

sentences.en: But the second reason is quality.
sentences.zh: 但第二个原因是质量。

sentences.en: Ultra HD Blu-ray is still widely considered to be the best technology for watching films at home.
sentences.zh: 超高清蓝光仍然被广泛认为是在家观看电影的最佳技术。

blocks.html_en: "20 years ago, Blu-ray set the standard for what a movie should look and sound like in the home, and it’s a standard both consumers and the industry recognized,” Matsuda tells me. “Ultra HD Blu-ray remains unsurpassed as the best overall experience for consumers.”

sentences.en: "20 years ago, Blu-ray set the standard for what a movie should look and sound like in the home, and it’s a standard both consumers and the industry recognized,” Matsuda tells me.
sentences.zh: “20 年前，蓝光为家庭电影的外观和声音设定了标准，这是消费者和行业都认可的标准，”松田告诉我。

sentences.en: “Ultra HD Blu-ray remains unsurpassed as the best overall experience for consumers.”
sentences.zh: “超高清蓝光仍然是无与伦比的消费者最佳整体体验。”

sentences.en: “The respective Blu-ray formats became the benchmark they chased, and in my opinion they still haven’t caught it.
sentences.zh: “各自的蓝光格式成为了他们追逐的基准，但在我看来，他们还没有抓住这一点。

sentences.en: Blu-ray and Ultra HD Blu-ray remain the reference,” Matsuda says.
sentences.zh: 蓝光和超高清蓝光仍然是参考，”松田说。

sentences.zh: “流可以近似它，但光盘承载完整的、未压缩的图像和声音，没有为了适应数据上限而丢弃任何内容。”

sentences.en: Olivier Semenoux, Europe head of GTM and Product Management at TCL Electronics, explains that much of that comes down to bitrate.
sentences.zh: TCL 电子 GTM 和产品管理欧洲主管 Olivier Semenoux 解释说，这很大程度上取决于比特率。

sentences.en: "Blu-ray can be coded up to 128Mbps because that's the disc's technical limit,” he explains.
sentences.zh: “蓝光光盘的编码速度可达 128Mbps，因为这是光盘的技术限制，”他解释道。

sentences.en: “Streaming is a different story, most popular platforms cap out natively around 25Mbps, with some going up to 40 or 80Mbps.”
sentences.zh: “流媒体则不同，大多数流行平台的原生上限约为 25Mbps，有些甚至高达 40 或 80Mbps。”

blocks.html_en: Unfortunately, the latter is very rare — when it comes to the big streamers, 16 to 18Mbps is the maximum you can expect.

blocks.html_en: This means that Ultra HD Blu-rays carry significantly more data per frame than a typical stream, meaning less compression and what you see at home is more of the original picture and sound being preserved. It's one of the reasons discs continue to set the standard for anyone who really loves home theater.

sentences.en: This means that Ultra HD Blu-rays carry significantly more data per frame than a typical stream, meaning less compression and what you see at home is more of the original picture and sound being preserved.
sentences.zh: 这意味着超高清蓝光每帧比典型流传输更多的数据，这意味着压缩更少，您在家里看到的更多的是原始图像和声音被保留。

sentences.en: It's one of the reasons discs continue to set the standard for anyone who really loves home theater.
sentences.zh: 这是光盘继续为真正热爱家庭影院的人设定标准的原因之一。

blocks.html_en: Variations of the same argument came up repeatedly in conversations with manufacturers too. I spoke with Rob Jones, President of Magnetar, a manufacturer of high-end 4K UHD Blu-ray and universal disc players. “When consumers invest in physical media, they get ownership, content preservation, and quality control,” he says. “While streaming is incredibly convenient, it cannot match physical media when it comes to that combination.” Jones says that’s what continues to drive Magnetar’s investment and development in this space.

sentences.en: Variations of the same argument came up repeatedly in conversations with manufacturers too.
sentences.zh: 在与制造商的对话中，同一论点的不同版本也反复出现。

sentences.en: I spoke with Rob Jones, President of Magnetar, a manufacturer of high-end 4K UHD Blu-ray and universal disc players.
sentences.zh: 我与 Magnetar 总裁 Rob Jones 进行了交谈，该公司是一家高端 4K UHD 蓝光和通用光盘播放器制造商。

sentences.en: “When consumers invest in physical media, they get ownership, content preservation, and quality control,” he says.
sentences.zh: “当消费者投资实体媒体时，他们获得了所有权、内容保存和质量控制，”他说。

sentences.en: “While streaming is incredibly convenient, it cannot match physical media when it comes to that combination.”
sentences.zh: “虽然流媒体非常方便，但就这种组合而言，它无法与物理媒体相媲美。”

sentences.en: Jones says that’s what continues to drive Magnetar’s investment and development in this space.
sentences.zh: 琼斯表示，这就是继续推动 Magnetar 在这一领域投资和发展的动力。

blocks.html_en: But that doesn't necessarily mean streaming and Blu-ray are in competition. One of the more surprising things I heard was that several companies see them as complementary rather than competing technologies.

sentences.en: But that doesn't necessarily mean streaming and Blu-ray are in competition.
sentences.zh: 但这并不一定意味着流媒体和蓝光存在竞争。

sentences.zh: 我听到的更令人惊讶的事情之一是，有几家公司将它们视为互补而非竞争技术。

blocks.html_en: "We see many customers choosing both formats," Kenichi Ikenoue, Head of Strategic Planning at Panasonic Consumer Europe, tells me. sentences.en: "We see many customers choosing both formats," Kenichi Ikenoue, Head of Strategic Planning at Panasonic Consumer Europe, tells me.
sentences.zh: “我们看到许多客户选择这两种格式，”松下欧洲消费者战略规划主管 Kenichi Ikenoue 告诉我。

sentences.en: "They enjoy the convenience of streaming for everyday viewing while turning to physical media when they want the highest picture and sound quality or want to own their favorite films."

blocks.html_en: If Blu-ray still has loyal fans, isn’t the next step an 8K successor? That's what I expected to find, as someone who isn't deep on movie production. Instead, almost every expert I spoke to questioned whether there was any need for a successor at all.

sentences.en: If Blu-ray still has loyal fans, isn’t the next step an 8K successor?
sentences.zh: 如果蓝光还有忠实粉丝，下一步不就是8K的继任者吗？

sentences.en: That's what I expected to find, as someone who isn't deep on movie production.
sentences.zh: 作为一个对电影制作并不深入的人，这就是我期望找到的。

sentences.en: Instead, almost every expert I spoke to questioned whether there was any need for a successor at all.
sentences.zh: 相反，几乎每一位我采访过的专家都质疑是否需要继任者。

blocks.html_en: "Honestly, I don't think so, at least not right now," says Victor Matsuda. "From a BDA [Blu-ray Disc Association] perspective, we don't see anything from content creators or consumers to indicate a need for a new format. They’re both extremely satisfied.”

sentences.en: "Honestly, I don't think so, at least not right now," says Victor Matsuda.
sentences.zh: “老实说，我不这么认为，至少现在不是，”维克多·松田说。

sentences.en: "From a BDA [Blu-ray Disc Association] perspective, we don't see anything from content creators or consumers to indicate a need for a new format.
sentences.zh: “从 BDA [蓝光光盘协会] 的角度来看，我们没有看到内容创作者或消费者有任何迹象表明需要新格式。

sentences.en: They’re both extremely satisfied.”
sentences.zh: 他们俩都非常满意。”

blocks.html_en: There are signs elsewhere that the industry isn't preparing for another optical disc format either. Now, while that decision applies to blank recording discs rather than pre-recorded movie discs, it seems to reflect a broader shift away from consumer physical media formats.

sentences.en: There are signs elsewhere that the industry isn't preparing for another optical disc format either.
sentences.zh: 其他地方也有迹象表明，该行业也没有为另一种光盘格式做好准备。

sentences.en: In 2025, Sony announced that it was ending the production of recordable Blu-ray discs, MiniDiscs and MiniDV cassettes, saying that there would be "no successor models".
sentences.zh: 2025年，索尼宣布停止生产可刻录蓝光光盘、MiniDiscs和MiniDV磁带，并表示“不会有后续型号”。

sentences.en: Now, while that decision applies to blank recording discs rather than pre-recorded movie discs, it seems to reflect a broader shift away from consumer physical media formats.
sentences.zh: 现在，虽然该决定适用于空白录制光盘而不是预先录制的电影光盘，但它似乎反映出消费者物理媒体格式的更广泛转变。

blocks.html_en: One obvious reason for a new format would be 8K support, which is a format that would theoretically offer four times the resolution of today's 4K discs. But that wasn't what the experts I spoke to had in mind.

sentences.en: One obvious reason for a new format would be 8K support, which is a format that would theoretically offer four times the resolution of today's 4K discs.
sentences.zh: 推出新格式的一个明显原因是支持 8K，这种格式理论上可提供当今 4K 光盘分辨率的四倍。

blocks.html_en: "The resolution race is interesting, but I don't see 8K finding a place with consumers anytime soon," Matsuda says. sentences.zh: “分辨率竞赛很有趣，但我认为 8K 不会很快在消费者中占据一席之地，”松田说。

blocks.html_en: Jones agreed that 8K isn't ready for the mainstream, but says the challenge goes beyond content. It's also about the wider home theater ecosystem. "8K is a distraction until it's mainstream and the ecosystem simply does not justify it," he says.

sentences.en: And it seems as if lack of demand isn't the only reason experts are sceptical.
sentences.zh: 似乎需求不足并不是专家们持怀疑态度的唯一原因。

sentences.en: Some argue we've reached the point where higher resolutions matter much less than other improvements we can make to picture quality.
sentences.zh: 一些人认为，我们已经达到了这样的程度：更高的分辨率远不如我们对图像质量所做的其他改进重要。

sentences.en: "HDR and wide colour gamut make a far bigger difference to perceived picture quality than resolution does," Semenoux tells me.

blocks.html_en: Which means the challenge facing an 8K Blu-ray isn't just about a lack of content or compatible hardware; it's that the improvement itself may not feel significant enough to justify an entirely new format.

"Frankly, an 8K Blu-ray would be a technical feat in search of a commercial problem to solve,” he says. “There's still little native 8K content, 8K TV adoption is modest and streaming platforms will almost certainly meet mainstream demand before another optical format ever reaches critical mass."

sentences.en: That's exactly how Mark Vena, CEO and Principal Analyst at SmartTech Research, sees it.
sentences.zh: SmartTech Research 首席执行官兼首席分析师 Mark Vena 正是这么认为的。

sentences.en: "Frankly, an 8K Blu-ray would be a technical feat in search of a commercial problem to solve,” he says.
sentences.zh: “坦率地说，8K 蓝光将是一项技术壮举，旨在解决商业问题，”他说。

sentences.en: “There's still little native 8K content, 8K TV adoption is modest and streaming platforms will almost certainly meet mainstream demand before another optical format ever reaches critical mass."
sentences.zh: “原生 8K 内容仍然很少，8K 电视的采用率也很低，在另一种光学格式达到临界质量之前，流媒体平台几乎肯定能满足主流需求。”

blocks.html_en: In other words, it’s not as if we’re all sitting around waiting for a new format to happen, it’s more that it doesn’t really have a reason to exist.

sentences.en: In other words, it’s not as if we’re all sitting around waiting for a new format to happen, it’s more that it doesn’t really have a reason to exist.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这并不是说我们都在等待新格式的出现，而是它并没有真正存在的理由。

blocks.html_en: What creates a new format?

sentences.en: What creates a new format?
sentences.zh: 是什么创造了新的格式？

blocks.html_en: Vena’s point made me realize I'd been thinking about this the wrong way. Every major home video format solved an obvious problem. DVD improved on VHS by offering non-degrading video and the capacity for extra features. Blu-ray improved on DVD with the space for higher-quality video. And now we have Ultra HD Blu-ray, which improved on Blu-ray's quality further.

sentences.en: Vena’s point made me realize I'd been thinking about this the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 维娜的观点让我意识到我一直在以错误的方式思考这个问题。

sentences.en: Every major home video format solved an obvious problem.
sentences.zh: 每种主要的家庭视频格式都解决了一个明显的问题。

sentences.en: DVD improved on VHS by offering non-degrading video and the capacity for extra features.
sentences.zh: DVD 在 VHS 的基础上进行了改进，提供无损视频和额外功能的容量。

sentences.en: Blu-ray improved on DVD with the space for higher-quality video.
sentences.zh: 蓝光对 DVD 进行了改进，为更高质量的视频提供了空间。

sentences.en: And now we have Ultra HD Blu-ray, which improved on Blu-ray's quality further.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了超高清蓝光，进一步提高了蓝光的质量。

blocks.html_en: Crucially, each of those steps solved a real technical problem. But right now, there isn’t a real problem that a successor to Ultra HD Blu-ray could actually solve.

sentences.en: Crucially, each of those steps solved a real technical problem.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，每个步骤都解决了一个真正的技术问题。

sentences.en: But right now, there isn’t a real problem that a successor to Ultra HD Blu-ray could actually solve.
sentences.zh: 但目前，超高清蓝光的继任者还没有真正能够解决的问题。

blocks.html_en: Matsuda explained this to me using a framework from his time as a product planner that he calls "needs" and "seeds". A "need" is a problem consumers or the industry want solving. A "seed" is a new technology that has the potential to create that demand in the future.

sentences.en: Matsuda explained this to me using a framework from his time as a product planner that he calls "needs" and "seeds".
sentences.zh: 松田用他作为产品规划师时的框架向我解释了这一点，他称之为“需求”和“种子”。

sentences.en: A "need" is a problem consumers or the industry want solving.
sentences.zh: “需求”是消费者或行业想要解决的问题。

sentences.en: A "seed" is a new technology that has the potential to create that demand in the future.
sentences.zh: “种子”是一种新技术，有可能在未来创造这种需求。

blocks.html_en: "I don't see a compelling driver for a new format at the moment," Matsuda says. "I think it's unlikely that a new format would arise out of consumer demand as there doesn't appear to be an expressed need. Similarly, Ultra HD Blu-ray continues to deliver content that takes full advantage of display technologies so I don't see a need arising from the industry side."

sentences.en: "I don't see a compelling driver for a new format at the moment," Matsuda says.
sentences.zh: “目前我还没有看到新格式的令人信服的驱动力，”松田说。

sentences.en: "I think it's unlikely that a new format would arise out of consumer demand as there doesn't appear to be an expressed need.
sentences.zh: “我认为消费者的需求不太可能出现新的格式，因为似乎没有明确的需求。

sentences.en: Similarly, Ultra HD Blu-ray continues to deliver content that takes full advantage of display technologies so I don't see a need arising from the industry side."
sentences.zh: 同样，超高清蓝光继续提供充分利用显示技术的内容，因此我认为行业方面没有必要。”

blocks.html_en: Matsuda says that could change. "From a seed standpoint, companies may have some technologies in development that could plant those seeds,” he explains. “But in my view, if a driving factor ever prompts a new physical format, it will most likely be the emergence of content the internet infrastructure simply can't deliver at scale without compromising quality. As long as streaming can handle what people want to watch, I don't see any real pressure for a new disc."

sentences.en: Matsuda says that could change.
sentences.zh: 松田表示，这种情况可能会改变。

sentences.en: "From a seed standpoint, companies may have some technologies in development that could plant those seeds,” he explains.
sentences.zh: “从种子的角度来看，公司可能正在开发一些可以播种这些种子的技术，”他解释道。

sentences.en: “But in my view, if a driving factor ever prompts a new physical format, it will most likely be the emergence of content the internet infrastructure simply can't deliver at scale without compromising quality.
sentences.zh: “但在我看来，如果有一个驱动因素催生了一种新的物理格式，那么很可能是互联网基础设施无法在不影响质量的情况下大规模提供的内容的出现。

sentences.en: As long as streaming can handle what people want to watch, I don't see any real pressure for a new disc."
sentences.zh: 只要流媒体能够处理人们想要观看的内容，我就看不到新光盘有任何真正的压力。”

blocks.html_en: So a technological breakthrough on its own wouldn't be enough, a new format would also need the entire industry to then build around it.

sentences.en: So a technological breakthrough on its own wouldn't be enough, a new format would also need the entire industry to then build around it.
sentences.zh: 因此，仅靠技术突破是不够的，新业态还需要整个行业围绕它进行构建。

blocks.html_en: Panasonic’s Ikenoue makes the same point from a more commercial perspective. "A successor format would also depend on significant investment from film studios and content providers. New hardware alone would not be enough. The content ecosystem would also need to support a new format. For the moment it is difficult to see the requirement for a successor."

sentences.en: Panasonic’s Ikenoue makes the same point from a more commercial perspective.
sentences.zh: 松下的池上从更商业化的角度提出了同样的观点。

sentences.en: "A successor format would also depend on significant investment from film studios and content providers.
sentences.zh: “后续格式还取决于电影制片厂和内容提供商的大量投资。

sentences.en: New hardware alone would not be enough.
sentences.zh: 仅靠新硬件是不够的。

sentences.en: The content ecosystem would also need to support a new format.
sentences.zh: 内容生态系统还需要支持新的格式。

sentences.en: For the moment it is difficult to see the requirement for a successor."
sentences.zh: 目前很难看到对继任者的需求。”

blocks.html_en: A successor wouldn't just need a better disc, there’d have to be a need to even build that better disc in the first place. Only then would studios create the content, manufacturers would build the players, TV makers would support it and consumers would decide if it was worth upgrading. But right now none of the experts could identify a good enough reason.

sentences.en: A successor wouldn't just need a better disc, there’d have to be a need to even build that better disc in the first place.
sentences.zh: 继任者不仅需要一张更好的光盘，甚至必须首先需要构建更好的光盘。

sentences.en: Only then would studios create the content, manufacturers would build the players, TV makers would support it and consumers would decide if it was worth upgrading.
sentences.zh: 只有这样，工作室才会创作内容，制造商才会制造播放器，电视制造商才会支持它，消费者才会决定它是否值得升级。

sentences.en: But right now none of the experts could identify a good enough reason.
sentences.zh: 但现在没有一个专家能找出足够充分的理由。

blocks.html_en: What if the successor isn’t a disc at all?

sentences.en: What if the successor isn’t a disc at all?
sentences.zh: 如果后继者根本不是光盘怎么办？

blocks.html_en: That doesn't necessarily mean Blu-ray is the end of the story. Optical storage technology is still evolving. Companies are developing discs capable of storing far more data than today's Blu-rays, but the key thing is that they're aimed at archiving data on an enterprise scale rather than at home entertainment. Which means they aren’t about to become the next movie format that you’ll buy.

sentences.en: That doesn't necessarily mean Blu-ray is the end of the story.
sentences.zh: 这并不一定意味着蓝光就是故事的结局。

sentences.en: Optical storage technology is still evolving.
sentences.zh: 光存储技术仍在不断发展。

sentences.en: Companies are developing discs capable of storing far more data than today's Blu-rays, but the key thing is that they're aimed at archiving data on an enterprise scale rather than at home entertainment.
sentences.zh: 公司正在开发能够存储比当今蓝光光盘更多数据的光盘，但关键是它们的目标是在企业规模而不是家庭娱乐中存档数据。

sentences.en: Which means they aren’t about to become the next movie format that you’ll buy.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它们不会成为您将购买的下一种电影格式。

blocks.html_en: Instead, several people I spoke with pointed towards a future where the successor to Blu-ray isn't about discs. "If Blu-ray has a successor, it may not be something you can hold in your hand," says Mark Vena. Rather than another physical format, he believes the future lies in premium digital delivery through high-quality, studio-certified, lossless downloads stored locally on home servers or network-attached storage.

sentences.en: Instead, several people I spoke with pointed towards a future where the successor to Blu-ray isn't about discs.
sentences.zh: 相反，与我交谈的几个人都指出，未来蓝光的继任者将不再是光盘。

sentences.en: "If Blu-ray has a successor, it may not be something you can hold in your hand," says Mark Vena.
sentences.zh: “如果蓝光有继任者，它可能不是你能握在手里的东西，”马克·维纳说。

sentences.en: Rather than another physical format, he believes the future lies in premium digital delivery through high-quality, studio-certified, lossless downloads stored locally on home servers or network-attached storage.
sentences.zh: 他认为，未来不是另一种物理格式，而是通过高质量、工作室认证、本地存储在家庭服务器或网络附加存储上的无损下载来进行优质数字传输。

blocks.html_en: "This is why the real successor to Blu-ray, for most consumers, is not another disc at all," he says. "It's the combination of ultra high bitrate streaming, cloud libraries and AI-powered video optimization that's closing the quality gap."

sentences.en: "This is why the real successor to Blu-ray, for most consumers, is not another disc at all," he says.
sentences.zh: “这就是为什么对于大多数消费者来说，蓝光真正的继任者根本不是另一种光盘，”他说。

sentences.en: "It's the combination of ultra high bitrate streaming, cloud libraries and AI-powered video optimization that's closing the quality gap."
sentences.zh: “超高比特率流媒体、云库和人工智能视频优化的结合正在缩小质量差距。”

blocks.html_en: So maybe the future isn't about replacing Blu-ray with another physical format but instead preserving the quality of audio and visuals that enthusiasts value about Blu-ray without even needing a disc in the first place.

sentences.en: So maybe the future isn't about replacing Blu-ray with another physical format but instead preserving the quality of audio and visuals that enthusiasts value about Blu-ray without even needing a disc in the first place.
sentences.zh: 因此，也许未来不是用另一种物理格式取代蓝光，而是保留蓝光爱好者所看重的音频和视觉质量，甚至不需要光盘。

blocks.html_en: One possible future is already beginning to emerge. Kaleidescape, a company specializing in premium digital movie delivery, offers downloads with bitrates to match what Blu-ray is capable of, preserving much more picture and audio quality than traditional streaming services while still providing the convenience of instant access.

sentences.en: One possible future is already beginning to emerge.
sentences.zh: 一种可能的未来已经开始出现。

sentences.en: Kaleidescape, a company specializing in premium digital movie delivery, offers downloads with bitrates to match what Blu-ray is capable of, preserving much more picture and audio quality than traditional streaming services while still providing the convenience of instant access.
sentences.zh: Kaleidescape 是一家专门从事优质数字电影传输的公司，提供与蓝光相匹配的比特率下载，比传统流媒体服务保留更多的图像和音频质量，同时仍然提供即时访问的便利。

blocks.html_en: Kaleidescape even recently launched a new 'Cinematic 4K' format for movies, which it says will offer even higher-quality bitrates for video, promising over 100Mbps of average bitrate (not maximum), which it compared to 60Mbps of average bitrate for 4K Blu-ray in its own marketing materials.

sentences.en: Kaleidescape even recently launched a new 'Cinematic 4K' format for movies, which it says will offer even higher-quality bitrates for video, promising over 100Mbps of average bitrate (not maximum), which it compared to 60Mbps of average bitrate for 4K Blu-ray in its own marketing materials.
sentences.zh: Kaleidescape 最近甚至推出了一种新的“电影 4K”电影格式，据称该格式将为视频提供更高质量的比特率，承诺平均比特率超过 100Mbps（不是最高），而在其自己的营销材料中，4K 蓝光的平均比特率为 60Mbps。

blocks.html_en: "In 10 years, the highest-quality movies at home will be delivered digitally, not on disc," Tayloe Stansbury, chairman and CEO of Kaleidescape, tells me. sentences.en: "In 10 years, the highest-quality movies at home will be delivered digitally, not on disc," Tayloe Stansbury, chairman and CEO of Kaleidescape, tells me.
sentences.zh: Kaleidescape 董事长兼首席执行官泰洛·斯坦斯伯里 (Tayloe Stansbury) 告诉我：“十年内，家庭中最高质量的电影将以数字方式提供，而不是光盘。”

sentences.en: "Consumers will expect instant access, reference-quality presentation, and technology that evolves with each generation of content.
sentences.zh: “消费者将期望即时访问、参考质量的演示以及随着每一代内容而发展的技术。

sentences.en: That's the future Kaleidescape is building today."
sentences.zh: 这就是 Kaleidescape 今天正在构建的未来。”

blocks.html_en: However, for many fans of Blu-ray, the biggest hurdle here is still ownership and Kaleidescape's technical proficiency doesn't address that. It's a digital storefront, and the same concerns of losing access to things you've bought still applies.

sentences.en: However, for many fans of Blu-ray, the biggest hurdle here is still ownership and Kaleidescape's technical proficiency doesn't address that.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于许多蓝光粉丝来说，最大的障碍仍然是所有权，而 Kaleidescape 的技术熟练程度并不能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: It's a digital storefront, and the same concerns of losing access to things you've bought still applies.
sentences.zh: 这是一个数字店面，失去对所购买商品的访问权限的担忧仍然存在。

blocks.html_en: Kaleidescape told me that its priority is delivering the best possible digital collecting experience rather than addressing licensing, and it declined to comment on people's increasing concerns about this side of buying movies.

sentences.en: Kaleidescape told me that its priority is delivering the best possible digital collecting experience rather than addressing licensing, and it declined to comment on people's increasing concerns about this side of buying movies.
sentences.zh: Kaleidescape 告诉我，它的首要任务是提供尽可能最佳的数字收藏体验，而不是解决许可问题，并且它拒绝就人们对购买电影这方面日益增长的担忧发表评论。

blocks.html_en: Digital purchases may be able to close the gap on quality, but until they can offer the same promise of permanence as a disc, then physical media will continue to offer something digital can't.

sentences.en: Digital purchases may be able to close the gap on quality, but until they can offer the same promise of permanence as a disc, then physical media will continue to offer something digital can't.
sentences.zh: 数字购买或许能够缩小质量上的差距，但在它们能够提供与光盘相同的持久性承诺之前，物理媒体将继续提供数字所无法提供的东西。

sentences.en: Blu-ray remains resilient
sentences.zh: 蓝光仍然具有弹性

blocks.html_en: When I first started researching this story, I thought I'd be talking to experts about the technology that’s waiting to replace Blu-ray. But instead, I learned the future is a little more complicated than that.

sentences.en: When I first started researching this story, I thought I'd be talking to experts about the technology that’s waiting to replace Blu-ray.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次开始研究这个故事时，我想我应该与专家讨论即将取代蓝光的技术。

blocks.html_en: Every home video format in the past has reached a point where its limitations became too impossible to ignore. But Ultra HD Blu-ray appears to be in a different position. sentences.en: Every home video format in the past has reached a point where its limitations became too impossible to ignore.
sentences.zh: 过去的每一种家庭视频格式都已经达到了其局限性不容忽视的地步。

sentences.en: But Ultra HD Blu-ray appears to be in a different position.
sentences.zh: 但超高清蓝光似乎处于不同的位置。

sentences.en: According to the people building and supporting the format, there isn't an obvious problem left for another new type of disc to solve.
sentences.zh: 据构建和支持该格式的人员称，不存在需要另一种新型光盘来解决的明显问题。

sentences.zh: Catalog [旧版本] 表现非常强劲，同比仅下降 2%。

sentences.zh: 这是由珍藏版和铁盒书推动的，特别是 4K 超高清，它仍然是一种增长中的格式。”

blocks.html_en: In other words, older film releases are continuing to sell well, with premium collector editions helping to keep the market strong — and it's not just older enthusiasts buying discs today.

sentences.en: In other words, older film releases are continuing to sell well, with premium collector editions helping to keep the market strong — and it's not just older enthusiasts buying discs today.

content_html_zh:
蓝光今年已经问世 20 周年，尽管流媒体现在是大多数人观看电影的方式，但物理媒体的消亡还远未结束。 收藏家们仍在购买蓝光光盘，以获取新的修复版、特别功能或限量版套装，而年轻观众正在发现拥有自己的电影的价值，而不是面对自己最喜欢的电影一直在您身边消失。

历史课

蓝光在 2000 年代中期取代了 DVD。 它以用于读取数据的蓝紫色激光命名，提供高清视频和更大的存储容量。 2016年，推出了超高清蓝光，增加了4K分辨率和HDR。

在本文中，当行业专家提到“蓝光”时，他们通常谈论的是最新版本，即超高清蓝光，因为它仍然被认为是在家观看电影的最高质量的消费格式。

那么，如果人们仍然想在家中观看光盘上的电影，是否有即将推出的蓝光继任者可以提供新的东西呢？

之前的所有主要家庭视频格式最终都被取代。 VHS 让位于 DVD，然后 DVD 让位于蓝光。 作为一个欣赏蓝光电影质量但不是其背后技术专家的人，我认为会有一个简单的计划来取代它们。 也许是 8K 蓝光？ 也许是另一种我从未听说过的物理格式，因为家庭影院是我的兴趣而不是我的专长？

但在与分析师、硬件制造商和蓝光本身背后的组织交谈后，我发现他们中的大多数人并不认为另一张光盘即将问世。 事实上，没有明显的“下一种格式”即将推出，我想找出原因。

为什么蓝光仍然有忠实的粉丝

要了解为什么蓝光的未来是一个如此有趣的话题，首先需要了解人们为什么仍然购买它。 在我的每一次谈话中，最重要的原因都是：所有权。

“现在所有权比 2005 年更重要。 当您购买光盘时，您就拥有了该电影。 它永远是您的，以最好的形式存在，只要您需要，它就可以放在您的架子上，”蓝光光盘协会（蓝光光盘开发背后的组织）主席 Victor Matsuda 说道。

他告诉我，人们开始认识到这样一个事实：我们今天以数字方式“购买”的大部分东西实际上都是可以更改或消失的许可证。 他发表此番言论之前不久，索尼从人们的账户中无偿删除了 500 多部已购买的电影，与此同时，Disney+ 被迫在许多国家取消了 4K 和 HDR 支持。

订阅突发新闻、评论、观点、顶级技术交易等。

松田说：“我们经常听到人们抱怨无法访问他们认为已经购买的内容，甚至还针对这个问题提起了诉讼。” “光盘不存在这个问题。 没有人可以进入你的家并把它拿回来。”

多年来，我与许多实体媒体收藏家交谈过，所有权几乎总是他们提到的第一件事。 但第二个原因是质量。 超高清蓝光仍然被广泛认为是在家观看电影的最佳技术。

“20 年前，蓝光为家庭电影的外观和声音设定了标准，这是消费者和行业都认可的标准，”松田告诉我。 “超高清蓝光仍然是无与伦比的消费者最佳整体体验。”

他解释说，即使流媒体服务已经推出 4K 和 HDR，情况仍然如此。 “各自的蓝光格式成为了他们追逐的基准，但在我看来，他们还没有抓住这一点。 蓝光和超高清蓝光仍然是参考，”松田说。 “流可以近似它，但光盘承载完整的、未压缩的图像和声音，没有为了适应数据上限而丢弃任何内容。”

TCL 电子 GTM 和产品管理欧洲主管 Olivier Semenoux 解释说，这很大程度上取决于比特率。 “蓝光光盘的编码速度可达 128Mbps，因为这是光盘的技术限制，”他解释道。 “流媒体则不同，大多数流行平台的原生上限约为 25Mbps，有些甚至高达 40 或 80Mbps。”

不幸的是，后者非常罕见 - 对于大型流媒体，16 至 18Mbp​​s 是您可以期望的最大值。

这意味着超高清蓝光每帧比典型流传输更多的数据，这意味着压缩更少，您在家里看到的更多的是原始图像和声音被保留。 这是光盘继续为真正热爱家庭影院的人设定标准的原因之一。

在与制造商的对话中，同一论点的不同版本也反复出现。 我与 Magnetar 总裁 Rob Jones 进行了交谈，该公司是一家高端 4K UHD 蓝光和通用光盘播放器制造商。 “当消费者投资实体媒体时，他们获得了所有权、内容保存和质量控制，”他说。 “虽然流媒体非常方便，但就这种组合而言，它无法与物理媒体相媲美。” 琼斯表示，这就是继续推动 Magnetar 在这一领域投资和发展的动力。

但这并不一定意味着流媒体和蓝光存在竞争。 我听到的更令人惊讶的事情之一是，有几家公司将它们视为互补而非竞争技术。

“我们看到许多客户选择这两种格式，”松下欧洲消费者战略规划主管 Kenichi Ikenoue 告诉我。 “他们享受日常观看流媒体的便利，同时当他们想要最高的图像和声音质量或想要拥有自己喜欢的电影时，他们会转向物理媒体。”

为什么 8K 不是答案

如果蓝光还有忠实粉丝，下一步不就是8K的继任者吗？ 作为一个对电影制作并不深入的人，这就是我期望找到的。 相反，几乎每一位我采访过的专家都质疑是否需要继任者。

“老实说，我不这么认为，至少现在不是，”维克多·松田说。 “从 BDA [蓝光光盘协会] 的角度来看，我们没有看到内容创作者或消费者有任何迹象表明需要新格式。 他们俩都非常满意。”

其他地方也有迹象表明，该行业也没有为另一种光盘格式做好准备。 2025年，索尼宣布停止生产可刻录蓝光光盘、MiniDiscs和MiniDV磁带，并表示“不会有后续型号”。 现在，虽然该决定适用于空白录制光盘而不是预先录制的电影光盘，但它似乎反映出消费者物理媒体格式的更广泛转变。

推出新格式的一个明显原因是支持 8K，这种格式理论上可提供当今 4K 光盘分辨率的四倍。 但这并不是我采访过的专家的想法。

“分辨率竞赛很有趣，但我认为 8K 不会很快在消费者中占据一席之地，”松田说。 “内容社区，即好莱坞制片厂，以 4K 制作内容，并表示打算继续这样做。 此外，许多制造商已将 8K 从其产品阵容中剔除。”

琼斯同意 8K 尚未做好成为主流的准备，但他表示挑战不仅仅在于内容。 它还涉及更广泛的家庭影院生态系统。 “8K 会让人分心，直到它成为主流，而且生态系统根本无法证明它的合理性，”他说。

他指出，8K 播放器不仅需要 8K 光盘，还取决于兼容的电视、投影仪、AV 接收器和处理器。 “为了坐下来体验 8K 内容，观众的整个家庭娱乐链都需要支持 8K，”他说。 “消费者需要用能够支持 8K 的组件替换其娱乐链中的每个环节，这充其量也是不切实际的。”

似乎需求不足并不是专家们持怀疑态度的唯一原因。 一些人认为，我们已经达到了这样的程度：更高的分辨率远不如我们对图像质量所做的其他改进重要。 “HDR 和广色域对感知图像质量的影响远远大于分辨率，”Semenoux 告诉我。

这意味着 8K 蓝光面临的挑战不仅仅是缺乏内容或兼容硬件；还在于缺乏内容或兼容硬件。而是改进本身可能不足以证明全新格式的合理性。

SmartTech Research 首席执行官兼首席分析师 Mark Vena 正是这么认为的。 “坦率地说，8K 蓝光将是一项技术壮举，旨在解决商业问题，”他说。 “原生 8K 内容仍然很少，8K 电视的采用率也很低，在另一种光学格式达到临界质量之前，流媒体平台几乎肯定能满足主流需求。”

换句话说，这并不是说我们都在等待新格式的出现，而是它并没有真正存在的理由。

是什么创造了新的格式？

维娜的观点让我意识到我一直在以错误的方式思考这个问题。 每种主要的家庭视频格式都解决了一个明显的问题。 DVD 在 VHS 的基础上进行了改进，提供无损视频和额外功能的容量。 蓝光对 DVD 进行了改进，为更高质量的视频提供了空间。 现在我们有了超高清蓝光，进一步提高了蓝光的质量。

至关重要的是，每个步骤都解决了一个真正的技术问题。 但目前，超高清蓝光的继任者还没有真正能够解决的问题。

松田用他作为产品规划师时的框架向我解释了这一点，他称之为“需求”和“种子”。 “需求”是消费者或行业想要解决的问题。 “种子”是一种新技术，有可能在未来创造这种需求。

“目前我还没有看到新格式的令人信服的驱动力，”松田说。 “我认为消费者的需求不太可能出现新的格式，因为似乎没有明确的需求。 同样，超高清蓝光继续提供充分利用显示技术的内容，因此我认为行业方面没有必要。”

松田表示，这种情况可能会改变。 “从种子的角度来看，公司可能正在开发一些可以播种这些种子的技术，”他解释道。 “但在我看来，如果有一个驱动因素催生了一种新的物理格式，那么很可能是互联网基础设施无法在不影响质量的情况下大规模提供的内容的出现。 只要流媒体能够处理人们想要观看的内容，我就看不到新光盘有任何真正的压力。”

因此，仅靠技术突破是不够的，新业态还需要整个行业围绕它进行构建。

松下的池上从更商业化的角度提出了同样的观点。 “后续格式还取决于电影制片厂和内容提供商的大量投资。 仅靠新硬件是不够的。 内容生态系统还需要支持新的格式。 目前很难看到对继任者的需求。”

继任者不仅需要一张更好的光盘，甚至必须首先需要构建更好的光盘。 只有这样，工作室才会创作内容，制造商才会制造播放器，电视制造商才会支持它，消费者才会决定它是否值得升级。 但现在没有一个专家能找出足够充分的理由。

如果后继者根本不是光盘怎么办？

这并不一定意味着蓝光就是故事的结局。 光存储技术仍在不断发展。 公司正在开发能够存储比当今蓝光光盘更多数据的光盘，但关键是它们的目标是在企业规模而不是家庭娱乐中存档数据。 这意味着它们不会成为您将购买的下一种电影格式。

相反，与我交谈的几个人都指出，未来蓝光的继任者将不再是光盘。 “如果蓝光有继任者，它可能不是你能握在手里的东西，”马克·维纳说。 他认为，未来不是另一种物理格式，而是通过高质量、工作室认证、本地存储在家庭服务器或网络附加存储上的无损下载来进行优质数字传输。

“这就是为什么对于大多数消费者来说，蓝光真正的继任者根本不是另一种光盘，”他说。 “超高比特率流媒体、云库和人工智能视频优化的结合正在缩小质量差距。”

因此，也许未来不是用另一种物理格式取代蓝光，而是保留蓝光爱好者所看重的音频和视觉质量，甚至不需要光盘。

一种可能的未来已经开始出现。 Kaleidescape 是一家专门从事优质数字电影传输的公司，提供与蓝光相匹配的比特率下载，比传统流媒体服务保留更多的图像和音频质量，同时仍然提供即时访问的便利。

Kaleidescape 最近甚至推出了一种新的“电影 4K”电影格式，据称该格式将为视频提供更高质量的比特率，承诺平均比特率超过 100Mbps（不是最高），而在其自己的营销材料中，4K 蓝光的平均比特率为 60Mbps。

Kaleidescape 董事长兼首席执行官泰洛·斯坦斯伯里 (Tayloe Stansbury) 告诉我：“十年内，家庭中最高质量的电影将以数字方式提供，而不是光盘。” “消费者将期望即时访问、参考质量的演示以及随着每一代内容而发展的技术。 这就是 Kaleidescape 今天正在构建的未来。”

然而，对于许多蓝光粉丝来说，最大的障碍仍然是所有权，而 Kaleidescape 的技术熟练程度并不能解决这个问题。 这是一个数字店面，失去对所购买商品的访问权限的担忧仍然存在。

Kaleidescape 告诉我，它的首要任务是提供尽可能最佳的数字收藏体验，而不是解决许可问题，并且它拒绝就人们对购买电影这方面日益增长的担忧发表评论。

数字购买或许能够缩小质量上的差距，但在它们能够提供与光盘相同的持久性承诺之前，物理媒体将继续提供数字所无法提供的东西。

蓝光仍然具有弹性

当我第一次开始研究这个故事时，我想我应该与专家讨论即将取代蓝光的技术。 但相反，我了解到未来比这更复杂一些。

过去的每一种家庭视频格式都已经达到了其局限性不容忽视的地步。 但超高清蓝光似乎处于不同的位置。 据构建和支持该格式的人员称，不存在需要另一种新型光盘来解决的明显问题。 它仍然为大多数消费者提供最高质量的体验，并继续吸引愿意投资实体媒体的收藏家。

从最近的销售数据来看，蓝光市场比我预期的要健康得多。 电影销售和发行公司 Elevation Sales 的高级商业营销经理马克·弗兰普顿 (Mark Frampton) 表示，这种形式仍然具有显着的弹性。

“我们预测 2026 年将是市场稳定的又一年。 Catalog [旧版本] 表现非常强劲，同比仅下降 2%。 这是由珍藏版和铁盒书推动的，特别是 4K 超高清，它仍然是一种增长中的格式。”

换句话说，老电影发行继续畅销，优质珍藏版有助于保持市场强劲——如今购买光盘的不仅仅是老电影爱好者。

“尽管核心购买受众仍然是 35 岁以上的人群，但我们看到越来越多的年轻受众进入市场，”Frampton 告诉我。 “25 岁至 34 岁之间的人群是蓝光的第二大购买者。 但正经历‘数字疲劳’的 Z 世代和年轻的千禧一代（14 岁至 30 岁）也开始高度参与这种形式。”

更广泛的行业也描绘了类似的景象。 专门生产实体媒体的音乐制造商 Key Production Group 的集团销售联席主管 Kath Summersgill 指出，娱乐零售商协会的数据显示持续增长。 “实体电影市场的现状令人难以置信地鼓舞人心，ERA 的 2025 年数据显示蓝光销量增长了 19.5%，”她说。

现在，这些令人惊讶的健康数字并不意味着蓝光光盘将永远存在。 流媒体将继续改进，优质数字图书馆将变得更加复杂，像 Kaleidescape 这样的公司已经证明，高质量的电影不一定需要刻录在光盘上。

所有这一切都意味着另一种物理格式可能永远不会到来。 相反，家庭影院的下一个篇章可能是数字化的——但收藏家要信任数字图书馆还有很长的路要走。
